author.name: 着物オヤジ🧪実機実測レビュー

summary_md: **着物オヤジ🧪実機実測レビュー ([@kimonooyaji](https://x.com/kimonooyaji/status/2116667250338136571))** reports NVIDIA is adding a half-memory 64 GB **DGX Spark** at $4,999 while raising the 128 GB model to $6,950, and extrapolates from EVO-X2 measurements what models still fit in 64 GB ([DGX Spark 64GB vs 128GB analysis](https://kimono-oyaji.com/dgx-spark-64gb-vs-128gb-evox2/)).
